definitions.explanation: Both parents together. More formal than {両親|りょうしん}.

examples.japanese: {父母|ふぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧している。
examples.english: I am grateful to my parents.

examples.japanese: {父母|ふぼ}⟦{会|かい}→会：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席：02084_shusseki⟧。

examples.english: The debt of gratitude to one's parents is deep.

examples.japanese: {父母|ふぼ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧でいてくれることが、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧より⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: Nothing makes me happier than my parents being healthy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{二回|にかい}→二回：27625_nikai⟧、{父母|ふぼ}⟦{会|かい}→会：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれ→開く：01979_hiraku⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: At school, PTA meetings are held twice a year, where teachers and parents talk together.

notes:
USAGE: Formal written term for parents. ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧ is more common in everyday speech.

COMPOUNDS:
- {父母|ふぼ}⟦{会|かい}→会：noentry⟧ (PTA meeting, parents' association)
- ⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧ (grandparents)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧ - parents (more common in speech)
- お{父|とう}さんとお{母|かあ}さん - father and mother (casual)
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ - parent(s) (general term)

NOTE: Can also be read as ちちはは in some contexts, though ふぼ is more common.
